Firebase (instant notifications) - Al Abdo Toys

- google-services.json: public config of the Android app com.alabdotoys.app
  (Firebase project: alabdostore). Safe to keep in the repo.
- The server key is NOT here. It lives only in Cloudflare Pages ->
  alabdo-toys-site -> Settings -> Variables and secrets (Production) as the
  secret FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT. Never commit the service-account JSON file.
